Sam: Quick sync — closing the loop on the Liveness outage postmortem. I've consolidated action items below with proposed owners. Please ack, add Jira links if you create tickets, and set due dates.

Aisha: Thanks. Can you paste the list?

Sam: Sure — items:
1) Add alert for KV cache eviction spikes -> owner: Linda -> Jira: (TBD) -> due 2026-04-02
2) Backfill missing expvar metrics across prod pool -> owner: Praveen -> Jira: (TBD) -> due 2026-04-09
3) Canary rollout for kernel patch -> owner: Mike -> Jira: RED-4123 -> due 2026-04-05
4) Run an eval to measure quality regression with quantized model -> owner: Olivia -> Jira: RED-4124 -> due 2026-04-12
5) Update runbook to include fallback routing -> owner: Aisha -> Jira: RED-4125 -> due 2026-04-01

DevOpsBot: New reminder created: weekly-remediation-tracker channel pinned.

Linda: I can take #1. I'll open a ticket now.

Mike: Took #3, will link RED-4123 here when created. Plan: canary tomorrow morning 08:30 UTC.

Praveen: Taking #2. Need access to the old expvar exporter — @Sam can you grant?

Sam: Granted. I also added a short note about recurring eviction pattern; seems related to bursty seq length from image-captioning endpoint. We should put this in the 'Recurring patterns' section of the PM.

Olivia: I'll own #4. Will run the eval on staging with 1000 prompts and compare token-level drift. Creating RED-4124 now.

Olivia: RED-4124 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4124

Aisha: For #5 I'll update the runbook and pair with SRE to test the fallback policy. Assigning RED-4125 to self.

Linda: RED-4126 created for #1: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4126

Praveen: RED-4127 created for #2: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4127

Mike: RED-4123 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4123

Sam: Nice. Can we add RACI to each ticket: set R=owner, A=Sam (product), C=SRE, I=eng@redwood? I'll attach a template to each ticket.

Aisha: Ack. I'll add the RACI fields in RED-4125 and tag @SRE-oncall for consultation.

Praveen: Quick Q: can we compress #2 timeline to 1 week? I can prioritize but need signoff.

Sam: If it's critical for stability, yes — move due to 2026-04-04. Mark as high priority.

Olivia: Also proposing a short postmortem follow-up meeting next Wednesday 09:00 PST to review progress and close items. Thoughts?

Mike: Works for me.

Linda: Works.

DevOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Follow-up meeting Wed 2026-03-31 09:00 PST.

Sam: Great. I'll prepare a one-slide status for that meeting with ticket links and current blockers. Everyone — please update your Jira by EOD Monday.

Aisha: Will do.

Praveen: Done.

Olivia: Done.

Mike: Done.

Linda: Done.

Sam: Thanks all. We'll re-open if anything slips. Closing thread for now :raised_hands:
